items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: He referred to the BAME system clarinet as a Fuki.

ctx.x: To find him, you've reminded me of that, you know. Uh, what Sidney Ayrton used to call a BAME system clarinet, what he called an Alba system. Yeah. What did you say it was? Well, Sidney referred to the Alba system clarinet as a Fuki.
He referred to the BAME system clarinet as a Fuki. D-F bamboo
